name: Linecast
author: Jordan Thomas (JMThomas00)
description: Companion to the Omarchy weather widget, backed by the linecast CLI (https://github.com/ashuttl/linecast): shows the current temperature in the bar, and opens a full dashboard with Weather, Radar, Sunshine, Moon, Tides, and Maps tabs, all live-animated and driven by real keyboard/mouse input, not just a static snapshot.

barWidget.description: Current temperature in the bar; click for a live, interactive linecast dashboard (weather/radar/sunshine/moon/tides/maps)
